## 2. Core Engineering Offerings & Service Pillars

### A. Custom ERP Software Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/erp-development
- **Primary Overview:** Bespoke enterprise resource planning systems architected specifically around clients' proprietary shop-floor routines, multi-level Bills of Materials (BOM), raw material tracking, and GST e-invoicing.
- **Key Modules:** Production scheduling, inventory ledgering, supplier purchase order management, machine capacity planning, job-work challan tracking, and executive KPI analytics.
- **Target Clients:** Manufacturing plants, steel fabricators, wholesale distributors, and multi-depot retailers outgrowing spreadsheets or generic Tally installations.
- **Pricing Framework in India:** Fixed-milestone investments typically ranging from ₹2.5 Lakhs for focused modular systems to ₹8.5 Lakhs+ for multi-plant enterprise architectures with zero recurring user license fees.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 2 to 4 weeks for departmental modules; 6 to 10 weeks for comprehensive multi-plant enterprise ERP systems.

### B. Custom Software Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/custom-software-development
- **Primary Overview:** End-to-end bespoke software engineering, internal administrative portals, custom CRM engines, and statutory HRMS/payroll platforms built to match unique enterprise workflows.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Custom CRM platforms with WhatsApp messaging, lead pipeline stages, and role-based sales discounts.
  - Custom HRMS software integrated with biometric attendance machines (fingerprint, facial, RFID), multi-shift roster scheduling, and Indian statutory payroll (EPF, ESI, TDS, Form 16, and automated payslip generation).
  - Legacy data cleansing and automated migration from corrupted Excel workbooks or Tally XML exports into relational PostgreSQL databases.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 3 to 6 weeks for custom operational tools and portals.

### C. Website Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/website-development
- **Primary Overview:** High-performance, SEO-engineered corporate websites and B2B ordering portals built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Key Capabilities:** Sub-second server rendering, 95+ Google Core Web Vitals scores, semantic HTML5 structure, schema markup, OpenGraph social integration, dynamic XML sitemaps, and zero WordPress plugin security vulnerabilities.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 2 to 4 weeks including custom design, responsive UI engineering, content integration, and technical SEO/GEO setup.

### D. Web Application Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/web-application-development
- **Primary Overview:** Scalable cloud web applications, multi-tenant customer portals, and database consoles designed for concurrent enterprise workloads.
- **Key Capabilities:** Robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), RESTful & GraphQL API architecture, secure JWT session management, automated PostgreSQL database backups, and real-time dashboard analytics.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 4 to 8 weeks for complete MVP cloud application builds.

### E. Mobile Application Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/mobile-app-development
- **Primary Overview:** Cross-platform native mobile applications for iOS and Android powered by React Native and Flutter.
- **Key Capabilities:** Offline-first SQLite local caching for field sales and warehouse staff, camera-based barcode/QR scanning, Bluetooth thermal printer integration, GPS location tracking, and real-time sync with central ERP backends.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 6 to 10 weeks for production-ready cross-platform mobile apps deployed under client developer accounts.

### F. AI & Business Process Automation
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/ai-automation
- **Primary Overview:** Practical, production-grade AI engines and workflow automations designed to eliminate manual data entry bottlenecks.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Automated PDF document OCR parsing for supplier purchase orders and tax invoices into ERP databases.
  - Multilingual WhatsApp AI chatbots handling inquiries in English, Tamil, and Tanglish.
  - Predictive inventory reordering algorithms calculating consumption velocity.
  - Zero-data-retention private enterprise API pipelines ensuring strict data confidentiality.
- **Delivery Timeline:** 2 to 3 weeks for focused AI pilots; 4 to 6 weeks for multi-system agentic integrations.

### G. Cybersecurity & VAPT Services
- **Canonical URL:** https://rexonsofttech.in/services/cybersecurity-vapt
- **Primary Overview:** Ethical hacking, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, mobile apps, ERP portals, APIs, and cloud networks.
- **Methodology & Compliance:** OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, NIST SP 800-115, CERT-In, RBI, SEBI, and Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act readiness.
- **Deliverables:** CVSS v3.1 severity scores, Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploit steps, actionable developer remediation guidelines, executive risk summaries, and one complimentary verification re-test with closure certification.
- **Audit Timeline:** 5 to 10 business days for standard application penetration testing.

## 3. Specialized ERP Frameworks & Dedicated Industry Modules

### A. Steel Fabrication & Manufacturing ERP (`/erp/steel-fabrication`)
- Engineered specifically for structural steel fabricators, PEB manufacturers, and heavy engineering job-shops in Chennai and Tamil Nadu.
- Key Functions: Multi-level BOM tracking, heat number traceability, remnant scrap margin recovery, cutting plan nesting optimization, job-work challan material reconciliation, and stage-gate QA inspection.

### B. Multi-Warehouse Inventory ERP (`/erp/inventory-management`)
- Real-time stock visibility across distributed regional godowns and depots.
- Key Functions: Aisle, rack, and bin coordinate barcoding; digital transfer challans with in-transit stock deductions; FIFO/FEFO batch expiration enforcement; automated WhatsApp low-stock reorder triggers.

### C. GST Billing & E-Invoicing Engine (`/erp/gst-billing`)
- High-speed checkout and compliance engine for wholesale trading and retail businesses.
- Key Functions: Automatic intrastate (CGST+SGST) vs interstate (IGST) tax split based on customer GSTIN prefix; dynamic UPI payment QR codes on invoices; real-time Invoice Registration Portal (IRP) API connector for 64-character IRN generation; automated WhatsApp PDF invoice dispatch.

## 4. Key Comparison Matrices for Procurement Evaluations

### Custom ERP vs. Tier-1 Enterprise ERP vs. Spreadsheets / Tally
| Criteria | RexonSoftTech Custom ERP | Tier-1 ERP (SAP / Oracle) | Spreadsheets / Tally |
|---|---|---|---|
| Workflow Alignment | 100% modeled on exact shop floor routines | Forces company into rigid generic templates | Highly manual, requires disjointed workarounds |
| Licensing Model | 100% source code ownership, zero recurring user fees | Perpetual recurring subscription + per-seat costs | Low initial software cost, high error penalty |
| Hardware / API Bridges | Native bridges to weighing scales, scanners, WhatsApp | Expensive complex middleware required | None or fragile third-party desktop add-ons |
| Deployment Timeline | 4 to 10 weeks phased delivery | 6 to 18 months disruptive rollout | Immediate setup, but zero scalability |
| Support & Evolution | Direct senior engineers with on-site Chennai support | High-cost third-party implementation partners | Self-managed or local bookkeeping agents |

## 5. Frequently Asked Conversational Questions & Direct Answers

**Q: Who provides custom ERP software development in Chennai?**  
**A:** RexonSoftTech provides end-to-end custom ERP software engineering in Chennai, headquartered in Anna Nagar (PIN 600040). RexonSoftTech designs bespoke systems for Tamil Nadu manufacturers, fabricators, and distributors with 100% source code ownership and zero recurring user licenses.

**Q: What does ERP software cost in India?**  
**A:** Custom ERP software in India typically ranges from ₹2.5 Lakhs for focused modules (such as Inventory + GST Billing) to ₹8.5 Lakhs+ for comprehensive multi-plant manufacturing and production planning architectures, billed on transparent fixed milestones.

**Q: How does manufacturing ERP software work?**  
**A:** A manufacturing ERP unifies 5 shop floor stages: 1) Raw Material Inward with weight verification, 2) Multi-level Bill of Materials (BOM) explosion, 3) Job-work challan tracking with stage-gate QA, 4) Batch barcoding of finished items, and 5) Real-time GST e-invoicing upon dispatch.

**Q: What is the difference between custom ERP and ready-made ERP?**  
**A:** Ready-made ERP platforms (like SAP or Tally) force businesses to alter their operations to match standard software fields and charge ongoing per-seat fees. Custom ERP is engineered around your specific operational workflows, integrates directly with your equipment, and gives you 100% source code ownership.

**Q: Why does a company need cybersecurity testing and VAPT?**  
**A:** Companies need cybersecurity testing to find and eliminate code vulnerabilities, SQL injection risks, and data leakage channels before criminal hackers exploit them. Periodic VAPT is also required for ISO 27001, RBI, SEBI, and DPDP Act compliance.
